disclosure: Public SWE-bench issue statements and three read-only ranges of public Django baseline source at the pinned base commits are sent through real SDK tools. No reference patch, evaluation test patch, local secret or expected answer is sent.

native_summary_contract.retention: last units up to target token budget, kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.pinned: leading user statement always kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.boundary: Responses groups are never split across a call/output pair
native_summary_contract.acceptance: summary accepted only when it shrinks the payload
native_summary_contract.failure_policy: provider error leaves the input untouched
native_summary_contract.accounting: summary requests consume the same global request budget
native_summary_contract.regrowth_rule: an already-summarised payload is not summarised again until it grows 25%

budget_calibration.note: Budgets are declared in provider tokens and converted with a measured ratio.

citable_note: the flags stay false until an independent audit passes; this pilot is development evidence for this host configuration, because the three development tasks took part in building it

host_configuration.structured_final_answer: JSON issue/cause/fix/facts asked for in the prompt, identical for every arm, rendered by the frozen renderer, which is the final-answer path and the only validator

applied: The final response must be exactly one line, begin with RESULT, contain at most 160 characters, and follow this contract:
Replace angle-bracket fields with tool values.

strict_track: single line with the contract prefix
criteria.bounds_are_not_relaxed: at most 160 characters remains an acceptance condition

acceptance_line.line: per task, the plugin arm's strict track is at least the baseline's (the four conditions judged on the rendered line) AND the paired complete provider-token saving is positive for a majority of pairs AND the batch mean is positive; failures, cap hits, retries and summary requests are all charged to their arm
acceptance_line.strict_track: the four conditions judged on the rendered line: required facts present, frozen regex full match, single line with the contract prefix, at most 160 characters
acceptance_line.paired_statistic: paired complete provider-token totals per (task, repeat) pair, summary tokens and retry usage included in the arm they belong to
reported_with: per-arm failure decomposition: declared fact missing, rendered over-length, no answer, other
acceptance_line.bounds_are_not_relaxed: at most 160 characters remains an acceptance condition

trajectory_matched_subset.note: reported for explanation only: these are the pairs whose two arms took the same number of model calls, so they isolate the compression effect; the frozen verdict is decided on every pair of the matrix, never on this subset

trajectory_unmatched_subset.note: pairs whose arms differ in model calls; their spread is trajectory, not compression

pilot_report.acceptance_line: per task, the plugin arm's strict track is at least the baseline's (the four conditions judged on the rendered line) AND the paired complete provider-token saving is positive for a majority of pairs AND the batch mean is positive; failures, cap hits, retries and summary requests are all charged to their arm

previous_attempt.outcome: pilot 01 failed the frozen quality gate: one task's plugin strict track was below its baseline, and every over-length rejection there began as a declared-fact rejection whose diagnostic never named the 160-character bound

batch_report.post_render_over_160_note: measured over samples that produced an answer candidate; a sample that never reached the answer turn is counted under samples_without_a_candidate and is not a length measurement
batch_report.attainability_rule: every sample of the batch must render inside facts + frozen regex + 160 characters; a sample that cannot render counts as a failure and its share is reported

metering.cache_fields_fail_closed: missing fields are recorded as unknown, never as zero

prompt_cache.note: a batch whose provider omits the cache fields records them as unknown; the totals stay null rather than being reported as zero

stop_conditions: request cap 300 reached -> stop, keep the partial directory, continue later under a new experiment id; --resume may never be used to bypass the budget
any task whose plugin strict track is below its baseline -> the quality gate fails: stop and report, do not add samples to look for a positive
audit errors non-empty -> the batch may not be cited as an effective saving
any recorded sample missing its four condition flags -> stop
report_requirements: per-task and pooled paired mean saving with dispersion (stdev, min, max) and the count of positive pairs
per-arm failure decomposition: declared fact missing, rendered over-length, no answer, other
per-arm retry counts and per-arm summary calls
actual requests and dollar cost, with the cache split
the acceptance verdict recomputed independently by the audit, not copied from the runner
boundary wording: development evidence for this host configuration
